snippet.title: Ring Toss Legend Trailer
snippet.description:
Ring Toss Legend is a casual physics game where you toss rings onto prize pegs, earn coins, upgrade your skills, and chase bigger rewards as you explore new stages.
Check out game link here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4891410/Ring_Toss_Legend/
